# K-Dev Notes (notes.kamranx.dev)

> Engineering Documentation, CS Reference & Architecture Notes by Kamran Khan (@kamranxdev)

- **Platform Name**: K-Dev Notes
- **Canonical URL**: https://notes.kamranx.dev
- **Author / Developer**: Kamran Khan (kamranxdev)
- **Primary Domain**: https://kamranx.dev

## Overview
K-Dev Notes is the official computer science and software engineering reference repository created by Kamran Khan (@kamranxdev). It covers Data Structures & Algorithms, System Design, SQL & NoSQL Database Optimization, React, Next.js, Node.js, and DevOps workflows.
